labels.what: a descriptive breakdown of Stage G's total chi2 (FD-G-DIAG-DECLARATION.md); no new statistic
labels.units: relative_to_f: d = (f - g)/f, M = (C + V_g)/(f f^T); absolute: d = f - g, M = C + V_g. The total chi2 is the same in both; the eigenmodes, per-mode chi2, mode counts and shares are not
labels.modes: eigenmodes of M, lambda descending; each eigenvector signed so its largest-|loading| cell is positive
labels.shares: block share of a mode = v^T B v / lambda; the blocks partition M (control D6), so the shares sum to 1
labels.removed: descriptive: the chi2 with one block removed from M; a breakdown, not an alternative result
labels.stability: chi2 by Cholesky, mode sum, least squares, and with a ridge 1e-10 * mean(diag M) * I; ridge_sensitive above 0.001, methods_disagree above 1e-08; unstable if either or if Cholesky fails
labels.not: no reading, claim or paper text
